caption: The drawing features fifteen cloth sample fragments arranged in three rows on a plain, off-white background. The first two rows each have five diamond-shaped fabric fragments (numbered 1–10), while the bottom row holds five square or rectangular pieces (numbered 11–15). The diamonds in the first row display various floral and geometric patterns: number 1 has a light blue background with pink and purple flowers and green leaves; number 2 is green with black and white abstract shapes; number 3 is yellow with swirling lines and red floral accents; number 4 has a peach or salmon tone with pink flowers and dark green leaves; number 5 is tan with a repeating black and orange geometric pattern. The second-row diamonds: number 6 is red with black and yellow flourishes; number 7 is pale blue with white, blue, and maroon abstract shapes; number 8 is yellow with small green sprigs; number 9 is light blue with multicolored flowers; number 10 is royal blue with dark blue, black, and white designs. The bottom row contains five square samples: number 11 is green with small, scattered flowers; number 12 is pink with various lightly colored shapes; number 13 is a larger red square with a dense pattern of yellow flowers and black and green leaves; number 14 is pink with yellow floral and green leafy designs; number 15 is a small pinkish square with a dense red squiggle pattern. At the bottom right, the name "Francis Law Durand" is printed.
title: Detail of Quilt
